homepage.headline: Where Cultures Connect.
homepage.introduction: The Atlas is a student-led international publication bringing together journalism, culture, travel, creative writing and perspectives from around the world.

about.headline: About The Atlas
about.introduction: The Atlas brings together perspectives on culture, society, travel and the arts. We publish journalism, essays, creative work and personal narratives from our international student community.
